summary: Frontend redesign verification (iteration 2): Ember orange default accent, Namaste pill, animated footer cards, mobile/tablet responsiveness, Theme Studio switching, Cmd+K palette, and About page 'Currently working on' block. All targeted features pass.

tested_features.ember_default_accent: PASS — first paint shows orange CTAs without data-accent attribute. View Selected Work bg = rgb(242,110,54). --primary resolves to 'hsl(18 88% 58%)' in dark mode (the default).
tested_features.theme_studio_switching: PASS — Theme Studio popover opens via palette icon; clicking Ocean switches --primary to '190 88% 58%' and data-accent='ocean'; clicking Ember reverts (data-accent cleared, --primary back to '18 88% 58%'). Visual color flip works both directions.
tested_features.namaste_pill: PASS — [data-testid='hero-namaste-pill'] present and visible on desktop and mobile (390px). Text = '🙏 Namaste · welcome'. Bobbing + emoji wave animations render via Framer Motion (visible in screenshot above /now card).
tested_features.footer_animated_cards: PASS — [data-testid='footer-card-uses' | 'footer-card-guestbook' | 'footer-card-recent'] all present & visible. Disc3 spin, hover lift (y:-4), playing equalizer bars all render.
tested_features.cmd_k_palette: PASS — Ctrl+K opens command menu, the selected 'Home' item shows the orange Ember accent highlight (visible in screenshot).
tested_features.about_currently_working: PASS — 'Currently working on' highlight block renders with orange ping dot on /about.
tested_features.mobile_390: PASS — Home, /work, /about, /links, /guestbook, /resume — all sw==cw (no horizontal overflow). Hero stacks vertically, pill renders above /now card.
tested_features.tablet_768: PASS — No horizontal overflow on homepage; footer cards display 2-col with Recent Favorite full-width as designed (sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-1).

critical_code_review_comments: Theme switch: clicking Ember preset removes data-accent rather than setting data-accent='ember'. Visual result is identical (root primary already 18 88% 58% in dark), but for consistency consider always setting data-accent='ember' so the cascade is explicit and matches the other presets. Low priority.

Footer 'Recent Favorite' card links to https://open.spotify.com/album/namastute which is not a real Spotify ID — will 404 if clicked. Cosmetic only since user hasn't requested a real link, but worth flagging.
Footer copyright still says 'Current Version: 1.0 | Last Updated: July 2025' — stale text vs. Feb 2026 availability shown in hero. Minor copy inconsistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_2 redesign features verified on desktop (1920), tablet (768) and mobile (390). Pre-existing /guestbook 401 from Supabase confirmed still benign (graceful empty state). One RSC navigation warning observed during programmatic nav between /work and /about on a mobile reload — does not impact users, related to dev-server HMR.
